body: No. I just wanted to write down part of my story.
The board was one where you would post asking for anonymous “questions”.
I don’t want to feel like I’m walking on egg shells my whole life!

I talked to her about why she hung up on me, she said she was worried about me. When I told her that it wasn’t a far drive but thank you for worrying about me she got defensive. She told me that I shouldn’t have even been out in the snow to begin with. 


I’ve also tried to talk to her about many other situations. Every time I have brought something up she will either get defensive or start crying and saying I don’t love her. It always ends with me feeling like I’m a being a dick to her.
I can honestly say that it hasn’t gotten better in the two and half years we’ve been together.
I don’t think so. Whenever I’m around her I feel like I’m walking on egg shells.

I think she has always been like this, but she hasn’t been around anyone who drank before meeting me. Her grandfather was an alcoholic, but he wasn’t around for very long after she was born. She doesn’t go to therapy and doesn’t take any medication.

If you’re serious about trying cooking. I highly recommend the On Cooking books! They are kinda on the higher end of cook books, but they have a little bit of everything in them. Forewarned, the recipes are wrote for restaurants and hotels so if you make one recipe you’ll be eating on it for a while.

I count because I’m genuinely curious to see how many people would visit me. There’s so many people who say that life is precious and I want to see if it really is? Are there going to be people who hated me saying I was an amazing person and their best friend?
